fields.label: Issue Qty
fields.description: Metal issued onto the tree (Dept RM -> MSL). Written only by the Issue Material button.

fields.label: Receive Qty
fields.description: Metal drawn back out of the tree — by the casting Employee IR gain, or returned to Dept RM by the Receive Material button.

fields.label: Recd via Work Order
fields.description: The part of Receive Qty credited by a casting Employee IR receive, i.e. metal drawn out of the tree by a work order. Provenance only: wo_receive_qty + manual_receive_qty = receive_qty, and it is Receive Qty - not this column - that feeds Pending Qty.

fields.label: Recd via Tree Button
fields.description: The part of Receive Qty credited by this tree's own Receive Material button (MSL -> Dept RM). Provenance only; see Recd via Work Order.

fields.label: Recd Gross Wt (WO)
fields.description: Total received gross weight booked by casting Employee IR receives against this tree for this metal item. This is the weight the employee returned - NOT the metal drawn from the tree, which is only the gain over the operation's gross weight (that is Recd via Work Order). Informational: it never enters the ledger arithmetic.

fields.label: Loss Qty
fields.description: Metal written off from the tree to Dept Scrap. Written only by the Receive Material button / Submit Tree.
Pending Qty = Issue Qty - Receive Qty - Loss Qty
fields.label: Pending Qty
